notes:
- Improved taskbar behavior across Spaces, displays and fullscreen windows. Window actions verify their target before applying changes, and the taskbar restores window geometry after interrupted adjustments.
- Finder verifies the selected folder before writing and preserves existing files. ZIP creation requires a volume that can publish the complete archive safely.
- Battery Run handles sleep, wake, power transitions and clock changes more reliably. Air-quality widgets handle more source-page variations.
- Strengthened release and package verification.
